constraints.description: Every phase-plan detail and acceptance criterion maps to direct implementation, test, BDD, package, clean-room, or external-contract evidence.

validation.validation_method: Compare the plan section with the verification matrix and execute focused receipts.

constraints.description: Real persistence, two-client convergence, conflict behavior, echo suppression, and reconnect recovery are executable and deterministic.

validation.validation_method: Run the focused PGlite, Loro loopback, WebSocket channel, and real relay suites.

constraints.description: Mandatory dependency and behavior lanes cannot pass through skip, todo, environment gates, or missing-dependency early returns.

validation.validation_method: Run source guards and inspect focused test output for zero skip/todo results.

constraints.description: Every declared evidence path exists and is non-empty, JSON parses, strict OpenSpec and whitespace checks pass, and no task remains unchecked before archive.

validation.validation_method: Parse ledgers and reports, stat evidence, validate OpenSpec, and scan the task surface.

constraints.description: The sibling gateway job is manual-only, tarball-backed, free of local links, and never substituted for the mandatory local release gate.

validation.validation_method: Run actionlint, release/BDD guards, and the workflow-equivalent packed sibling contract.

constraints.description: Headless npm-sync readiness is not presented as Flutter, Tauri, production relay, showcase, Docusaurus, full-release, registry, or npm latest readiness.

validation.validation_method: Require in-progress coverage, planned downstream evidence, and explicit publication denial.

constraints.description: Screenshots are non-applicable only because this change renders no surface; real browser, device, accessibility, trace, video/golden, and hash evidence remains mandatory downstream.

validation.validation_method: Review the changed artifact types and downstream visual owners.

global_rules: Do not authorize or perform registry publication.
Do not count the manual sibling job as mandatory stable evidence.
Do not weaken the phase-plan acceptance criteria.
Do not fabricate screenshots for a headless storage and sync contract.
termination_conditions: Focused tests, BDD, actionlint, evidence validation, strict OpenSpec, and clean CI pass.
No unsupported platform, visual, relay, certification, or publication claim remains.
